cells.title: Make the context mark line advisory
cells.action: Contract decision 48741dcf. In compute_handoff_warning (prompt_context.rs), keep the threshold read, the 150000 default and the 0 switch unchanged. Replace the format string with exactly: `context {n_k}k tokens (mark {t_k}k): keep working; hand off only on the user's word or at feature close`. Update the three tests at transcript_past_handoff_mark_carries_warning_line, transcript_below_handoff_mark_adds_no_line and handoff_context_tokens_zero_adds_no_line_at_any_size: the past-mark test asserts `context 160k tokens (mark 150k): keep working; hand off only on the user's word or at feature close`; the two no-line tests assert stdout does not contain `(mark ` and does not contain `keep working; hand off`. Red first: change the expected text, see the test fail, then change the string.

truths: past the mark the hook adds the advisory line with the token count and the mark
the line carries no stop order and no handoff steps
below the mark and with handoff_context_tokens 0 the hook adds no line
prohibitions: Do not change the default or the 0 switch

cells.title: Rewrite the context handoff rule as advisory in every home
cells.action: Rewrite rule agents-context-handoff-65 per decision a23d677e in every home. New meaning, in short plain sentences: a session never interrupts work at a context mark; it finishes the task. The hook may show the context size against the mark (handoff_context_tokens, default 150000); that line is advice, not a stop. A handoff is written only when the user asks for a switch or at feature close. Then it goes through the host's leader door: waggledance_dispatch with leader: true and follow_up_of naming the current run, so the successor joins the same run family. Never a self-spawned Paseo agent, never tell the user to open a new session. Show the handoff and wait only when a gate or decision the user owns is pending, or when the host has no leader door. Homes: packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md (the § Care for the session bullet under the rule marker), then run `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` so AGENTS.md and the rendered skill copies follow; skills/bee-hive/SKILL.md line 111; skills/bee-hive/references/go-mode.md lines 117 and 124 (no mid-swarm stop; landing a slice before a user-asked switch stays); skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md lines 116 and 196; skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md line 165 (keep the line 242 worker [HANDOFF] token: a worker window is out of scope); skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md near line 746 and 780 (the HANDOFF.json schema stays); docs/handbook/stages/swarming.md near line 97; docs/handbook/architecture-map.md line 103 (swarming to paused on the user's word or feature close); docs/02-architecture.md line 244; README.md lines 100 and 508. Knowledge: in the rule index entry for agents-context-handoff-65 (router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md line 222), rewrite the spoken form and cite D1 and D3 of docs/history/context-mark-advisory; in docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/token-economy-of-injected-context.md near line 115, replace the hook line with `context <N>k tokens (mark <T>k): keep working; hand off only on the user's word or at feature close` and say it is advisory. In docs/history/handoff-self-relaunch/promote-proposals.md, mark the old stop-at-mark proposal superseded by docs/history/context-mark-advisory D3 (decision a23d677e supersedes c9439edb). Reserve the release manifest before regen. List every file regen changed in the cap and name the rendered copies as a scope deviation.

truths: no home tells a session to stop or hand off at the context mark
every home says a handoff happens only on the user's word or at feature close
the handoff dispatch names waggledance_dispatch with leader: true and follow_up_of the current run
